## Summary

Describe the observable behavior or evidence change.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated a fixture-backed test before production behavior.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` pass.
- [ ] Generated output, if any, is deterministic and contains no credentials or local absolute paths.

## Registry submissions

- [ ] The slug is stable and unique.
- [ ] npm sources use an exact version, or GitHub sources use a full 40-character commit SHA.
- [ ] The metadata is factual and does not claim that a package is safe or officially endorsed.

## Rule changes

- [ ] The rule keeps a stable ID and includes positive and negative fixtures.
- [ ] Severity, evidence wording, remediation, and false-positive impact are documented.
